name: The Prophet Rohini

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: psychic damage, and Rohini slides the target up to 2 squares.

The target cannot attack Rohini and takes ongoing 10 fire and psychic damage (save ends both). Until the effect ends, the target cannot willingly end its turn farther away from Rohini than where it started. This effect ends if Rohini attacks the target or uses the power against a different creature.
The target is dominated until the end of Rohini’s next turn.

effect.description: Rohini alters her physical form to appear as a member of any Medium humanoid race (including a unique individual) until she uses change shape again or until she drops to 0 hit points. To assume a specific individual’s form, Rohini must have seen that individual. Other creatures can make a DC 30 Insight check to discern that the form is a disguise.

powers.name: Mind-Warped Bodyguard
powers.trigger: A melee or a ranged attack targets Rohini while she is within 5 squares of a creature affected by her soul-wrenching kiss.

effect.description: Rohini and the creature affected by her soul-wrenching kiss teleport, swapping positions, and the triggering attack instead targets that creature.
